reason: Research was thin: one WebSearch on VZ found no October 2026 news, only the late-June spin-off/JV and cost-cut headlines, so this rests mostly on the packet. NAV is +1.14% with 32% cash as ballast. VZ is -16.1% against its 18% stop (about $40.70, 2.3% below the $41.65 mark), so the standing stop already manages the one weak leg. Selling now would pay churn costs and lock in a loss on a 6%+ yield name without a new catalyst. MO, BTI and PFE are modestly positive and C is -5% against a 20% stop. No evidence found to justify replacing any thesis, so I keep the book and stops unchanged.
